name: Spotify Pulse
author: iammhador
description: An animated Spotify player for the bar: Song — Artist, album-colored player card, karaoke lyrics, real audio visualizer, recently played and a sleep timer

barWidget.description: Now playing on Spotify, with an animated player card on click

schema.label: Max text width (px)
schema.description: Longer titles scroll or get cut off.

schema.label: Bar style
schema.description: cover: the album art with progress around it. wave: a flowing wave in a progress ring.

schema.label: Progress in the bar
schema.description: Progress around the bar's cover (or ring around the wave).

schema.label: Lyrics in the bar
schema.description: Show the line being sung instead of the title. Looks lyrics up on lrclib.net.

schema.label: Album colors
schema.description: Theme the card from the album cover.

schema.label: Karaoke sweep
schema.description: Fill the current lyric line as it's sung.

schema.label: Audio visualizer
schema.description: Real audio levels when cava is installed.

schema.label: Recently played
schema.description: Remember tracks and today's listening stats in ~/.local/state/spotify-pulse.

schema.label: Sleep timer fade-out
schema.description: Ease the volume down before the sleep timer pauses (30 s, or 10 s for 'after this song').
